description: The bar chart titled "Recall@10" compares the performance of different methods in terms of recall at 10. The vertical axis represents recall values, ranging from 0.1 to 0.4, while the horizontal axis lists four methods: "Ours," "Critiquing," "Scoring," and "Ranking." The "Ours" method has the highest recall value, approximately 0.35, followed by "Critiquing" with a value around 0.3. "Scoring" has a significantly lower recall value, close to 0.15, and "Ranking" has a recall value slightly above 0.2. The bars are colored differently, with "Ours" in orange and the other methods in shades of blue. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or emphasis on the bars.
